method: One full npm test per source revision. File+test name+first assertion+first message matched exactly. Raw logs preserved. Three baseline cases were exposed to a brief data edit; entire affected files rerun on restored main (30 PASS/1 SKIP). Four stale expectations (existing ceiling4, normal sector lengths in two checks, and host compiler selection) were corrected and the full affected file passes inside final focused run (77 PASS/2 SKIP). Task parser receives its own source root, preserving test-file first-assertion selection and exact messages. Host variant manifest correction separately rerun through build-variants and wall-trace/frame routes plus native pilots. No second full suite.
